title_as_printed: Experimental VLLE Data for [CH4 (1) + CO2 (2) + H2O (3)] at Temperatures T and Pressures p, Where xi Denotes the Mole Fraction of Component i and u(xi) Denotes Standard Uncertainty of xi

footnotes_as_printed.a: The phases are labeled as I, II, and III for the gas, CO2-rich liquid, and water-rich phases, respectively.

temperature_scale: ITS-90 (PRT calibrated on ITS-90, stated in section 2.3)
pressure_note: absolute cell pressure from a calibrated transducer (standard uncertainty 5 kPa); total pressure of the coexisting phases; each phase was sampled at its own recorded pressure, so p differs slightly between the I, II and III rows of one state point

value.what: CO2 in the aqueous phase III

value2.what: CH4 in the aqueous phase III

y_co2_gas.what: CO2 in the gas phase I

y_ch4_gas.what: CH4 in the gas phase I

y_h2o_gas.what: H2O in the gas phase I

skip_rows.reason: isotherm label rows (T = ... K); the T = 292.65 K label is printed twice (page break)

extra_unmapped: x3, u(x3) (H2O mole fraction of phase III)
notes: Three fluid phases coexist (VLLE): I = gas, II = CO2-rich liquid, III = water-rich (aqueous) liquid; rows come in I/II/III triplets, one triplet per state point (31 state points on 8 isotherms 285.15-300.50 K). Temperature set per block from the label rows. No hydrate present (the authors place these states between the Lw+LCO2+V curve and the UCEP or quadruple locus). This mapping: aqueous-phase solubilities (phase III rows). regime lle because a CO2-rich liquid coexists. 2026-10-11 coordinator: gas_mixture true (two dissolved gases); these rows belong to the ternary family, which the v1.2 builder cannot yet write, so the release excludes them until a ternary converter exists. 2026-10-11 coordinator: ternary mapping (property ternary_state, converter conv_ternary) replacing the per-phase mappings, which are kept as *.json.txt. Al Ghafri numbering: x1 CH4, x2 CO2, x3 H2O. Three-phase VLLE (gas I, CO2-rich liquid II, aqueous III): the aqueous composition and the gas-phase water content are stored with y_co2_dry from phase I; phase II (liquid) has no column and is not built.
